title: PoppyAccessTokenResponse
description: A successful token endpoint response from sign-in, including Mediated Sign-In, or refresh (spec 4.7): an access token, Bearer by default or DPoP if the Company binds its tokens (spec 4.5), and a refresh token. The response isn't tied to a Session: signed-in requests carry the access token with the Session header. refresh_token is present after sign-in and when the Company rotates it. scope is left out only when the granted scopes equal those requested, and expires_in is recommended (RFC 6749 section 5.1). Unknown fields are allowed.
